svg.title: Which neuron fires?
svg.desc: A threshold network with four clue neurons (Ada, Ben, Monday, Tuesday) and three invoice neurons. Each invoice receives one synapse from its customer and one from its day and fires with two signals. The picture switches on every customer and day pair in turn: Ada and Tuesday fire invoice 104, Ada and Monday fire 207, Ben and Monday charge two invoices but fire none, Ben and Tuesday fire 319.

g.text: One signal per clue. Two signals fire an invoice.
